text.tspan: 168 variants, the one type every fallible API returns
a free static, NOT a predicate on Error

div.p: Predicates are not complements: Serialization and Wakeup are KafkaExceptions but not ApiExceptions. Callers match variants; C callers get kafka_common_Error_e plus the kafka_common_Error_is_* predicates.

text.tspan: Kafka variants — one per Java exception class
that are true for its extends chain
